authorization: Explicit user authorization limited to own report directory commit and ordinary push; original shared-container no-commit rule overridden only here.
self_reference_rule: This file cannot embed its own future Git commit/tree or post-commit transfer result. Final delivery supplies immutable commit/root tree/report tree and full remote readback receipt.

readback.method: Fresh independent /tmp object store, fetch dedicated branch only, no alternates, read and hash every report blob in full; compare path/mode/blob/bytes/SHA256 and both trees against immutable local commit.
